dedupe_keys.name: annual survey of public employment payroll aspep state and local government employees by function

description: The Annual Survey of Public Employment & Payroll (ASPEP) of the U.S. Census Bureau measures the number of state and local civilian government employees and their gross payroll for the month of March. Data give full-time, part-time and full-time equivalent employment and March payroll by government function, using 32 function codes that include highways, air transportation, sea and inland port facilities, sewerage, solid waste management, water supply, electric power, gas supply, transit, firefighters and police, for state governments, local governments and both, by state and for the nation. In March 2025 state and local governments employed 20.3 million people. Coverage: collected annually since 1957 except 1996, a full census in years ending 2 and 7 and a sample in between; tables on data.census.gov and in the API from 1992 to 2025 (2025 preliminary data released April 2026). Access: data.census.gov tables, individual unit files on the data tables page and the Public Sector: Public Employment and Payroll API (timeseries/govsemp, free key); free and public domain. Caveats: March payroll only; civilian employees only; sample years carry sampling error; functions follow the Government Finance and Employment Classification Manual and private utility staff are not included. Simulation uses: sizing public workforce available for operating and restoring water, sewer, highway, transit and utility systems, for example crew capacity assumptions in restoration and emergency response models. Related records: the government units listing, State and Local Government Finances and County Business Patterns for private sector employment.
